text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega ran a brilliant Debut race. 
Within her heart, feelings of joy, 
satisfaction, and—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was filled with relief, feeling as 
though she had atoned to her younger 
sister, if only a little.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Devoted entirely to the wish of offering a 
more brilliant glory to her sister, Admire 
Vega proposes the Hopeful Stakes as her 
next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer agrees as well, and even 
tougher training begins in preparation for 
the Hopeful Stakes.
